content: {"like":["Values high-quality, well-crafted musical performances and authentic, detailed portrayals of musicians; appreciates thoughtful cinematography with long, immersive shots and clear focus on performers; enjoys rich historical context and instructional depth in music-related content; favors films with strong visual storytelling and well-executed set pieces; appreciates clear, well-structured audio-visual presentations with accessible navigation."],"dislike":["Dislikes distracting or gimmicky camera work, excessive close-ups, and shaky handheld footage; rejects poorly edited or disjointed sequencing that obscures the narrative; finds genre clichés, melodramatic tropes, and overused plot devices off-putting; is critical of low production quality, sloppy packaging, and lack of clear labeling or organization; avoids content that feels overly commercial, inauthentic, or lacking in genuine artistic depth."]}
